benchmarks.protocol: 40 words per language, phonetized by alkove-lex alone (first pronunciation plus variants at 25 % or more). Per word, the threshold is set for the target false-alarm rate on half of the speakers, recall measured on the other half; false alarms counted on all the speech without the word. fr, en, es, it on MOCKS; ca, pt on Common Voice test. Romanian left out: its test set is too short to set a threshold at these rates.

metrics.recall: recall of the word, %, keyed by false alarms per hour

notes.after_pause_recall: only after a pause (the word said after 300 ms without speech), mean of the 6 languages
